native_six_session_probe.scope: Actual native process with local fake provider; direct dynamic-tool mode. Separate lifecycle tests explicitly force Code Mode.

full_proxy_sdk_probe.scope: Original09 SSE candidate, real LiteLLM CLI and SDK, fake bridge RPC; not a full combined-candidate multi-SDK gate.

strict_api_contract.messages: Original API receives the current full SDK messages each request. Native bridge only appends new user inputs and tool outputs; later system/assistant changes and compaction are not faithfully synchronized.
strict_api_contract.sampling: temperature, top_p and max_tokens are present in SDK/direct requests but are not mapped to native generation. Fixed model/low effort does not preserve these parameters.
strict_api_contract.tools: The original SDK executes external operations. Native Code Mode adds internal exec/wait sampling and pending-queue batching; the API response/tool batch boundary is different.
strict_api_contract.cancellation: Late-output recovery prevents observation loss but may append an extra native turn after a premature final. It is a compatibility repair, not exact original API lifecycle behavior.
strict_api_contract.instructions: Initial system/developer messages are combined into native base instructions, and the bridge adds external-tool instructions. Native environment context and orchestration instructions remain. Disabling bundled host skills removes only an unintended subset.
strict_api_contract.compaction: Default SDK automatic compaction was reproduced with a local prompt-too-long response. Current bridge creates a new native state or stops a persistent teacher. Disabling SDK compaction changes original behavior and was not adopted.
strict_api_contract.token_accounting: Normal native cumulative deltas are consistent. A native compaction fixture did not include the compaction response usage in cumulative token events; do not claim complete billing-equivalent usage.
strict_api_contract.historical_runtime: The handoff dependency list does not lock the historical SDK/model version; original code behavior and current retained runtime tests do not prove exact historical runtime identity.

not_validated: Any real-model run of the checked candidate
decision: Retain checked repairs and evidence; do not launch09 under a claim of original API equivalence. No new automatic retries or hash verification framework added.
